$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for BOSNIAN, Latin script (bs-BA): alerg (alergija, alergičan), (ne)tolerancija, osjetljiv, celijakija, anafilaksa, bez <allergen> (bez glutena, bez laktoze, bez mlijeka, bez jaja, bez kikirikija, bez orašastih plodova, bez lješnjaka…), bezglutensk / bezlaktozn, ne sadrži / nema glutena, sigurno / pogodno / prikladno za, može sadržati, tragovi, (unakrsna) kontaminacija, ne smijem / ne mogu jesti. š č ć ž fold away on both sides; đ is kept, so it is not used in a stem. Bare bez is NOT a stem (bez luka is a preference), nor bare siguran (jeste li sigurni = are you sure). OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
